semantics.what: Declared release-transaction phase for the package named by release/targets.json successor-stable. The registry's current published stable, the checked-in planned stable source target, and an active transaction artifact are separate facts. scripts/release-audit-tags.mjs composes the phase machine with the selected tuple's publication policy and fails CI when the live registry disagrees.
semantics.phase: One of at_rest | staged | approved | promoted | failed. An absent file means at_rest. At rest before 0.1.0, each dist-tag rests on the newest published prerelease ELIGIBLE for it under release/targets.json — latest == next == newest published for versions the manifest does not constrain, but a candidate the manifest publishes to next only leaves latest where it is.
semantics.kind: Required outside at_rest: prerelease | stable — the kind of the in-flight release transaction. null at rest.
semantics.version: Required outside at_rest: the active transaction artifact. stable selects successor-stable; prerelease selects successor-preview, so a preview artifact may differ from the checked-in planned stable source target. null at rest.
semantics.lifecycle: Changing this file is a reviewed commit. Release preparation advances the checked-in CLI, lock entry, and successor-stable tuple to the planned stable target, while this phase names the kind-selected artifact. Advance the phase through the transaction and return only the phase to at_rest once the registry reflects the settled tag state; do not roll the planned stable source target back.
